review.note: Retracted in M22: the spread of Xylella fastidiosa through southern European olive groves from 2013, which reached Portugal in 2019. The atlas holds nothing it can be argued to have changed — no record of the response, the inquiry or the rules that followed — and the disasters it does hold, the fires of 2017, are wired to each other and to the reform they produced. A disaster with no recorded consequence has no honest edge.
